subject: Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'NumMeasuredFeature' not found

messages.author: 7cec1ca129682d1f
messages.subject: Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'NumMeasuredFeature' not found
parts:
Hi Meena,

I'm trying to perform a group comparison with a linear model (summaryMethod="linear") using MSstats (daily v 3.3.11), but I'm getting this error message when I try to run the group comparison:

Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : 
  object 'NumMeasuredFeature' not found

Here are the commands I use:

quantData_Normalized_Linear<-dataProcess(raw, logTrans=2, normalization="globalStandards", nameStandards=c("DLATVYVDVLK","DYVSQFEGSALGK","LLDNWDSVTSTFSK","AELQEGAR","LSPLGEEMR","LAEYHAK"), betweenRunInterferenceScore=FALSE, fillIncompleteRows=TRUE, featureSubset="all", remove_proteins_with_interference=FALSE, summaryMethod="linear", equalFeatureVar=TRUE, filterLogOfSum=TRUE, censoredInt="NA", cutoffCensored="minFeature", MBimpute=TRUE, remove50missing=FALSE, skylineReport=TRUE)

write.csv(quantData_Normalized_Linear$ProcessedData,file="quantData_Normalized_Linear.csv")

comparison1<-matrix(c(1,-1,0),nrow=1)
comparison2<-matrix(c(0,-1,1),nrow=1)
comparison3<-matrix(c(-1,0,1),nrow=1)
comparison<-rbind(comparison1,comparison2,comparison3)
row.names(comparison)<-c("1-PFC-NONDEPxNAIVE","2-PFC-DEPxNAIVE","3-PFC-DEPxNONDEP")
resultComparison_quantData_Normalized_Linear<-groupComparison(contrast.matrix=comparison,data=quantData_Normalized_Linear)
resultComparison_quantData_Normalized_Linear$ComparisonResult
write.csv(resultComparison_quantData_Normalized_Linear$ComparisonResult, file="SignificantTestingResults_quantData_Normalized_Linear.csv") 

Do you have any idea what's going in? My analysis works when I run the exact commands with the exact data files, but use the TMP model (summaryMethod="TMP").

Thanks for your help.

Scott
